metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2013 · The Wolf of Wall Street

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2002 · Catch Me If You Can
metas.description: A runaway teenager lives an exciting life by forging checks and impersonating several professions, but his fraudulent activities soon attract the attention of the FBI.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2009 · Public Enemies

metas.description: In this story inspired by true events, Ron Stallworth, an African-American Colorado police officer, successfully infiltrates the local branch of the Ku Klux Klan with the help of a white Jewish colleague.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2016 · War Dogs
metas.description: Loosely based on the true story of two young men, David Packouz and Efraim Diveroli, who won a three hundred million dollar contract from the Pentagon to arm America's allies in Afghanistan.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1975 · Dog Day Afternoon

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2008 · Changeling
metas.description: After Christine's son goes missing, she reaches out to the LAPD to find him, but when they try to pass off an impostor as her son to quiet public protests, she refuses to accept him or give up hope.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1969 · Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2015 · Legend

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2007 · The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2017 · Molly's Game

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1993 · In the Name of the Father

metas.description: The true story of Whitey Bulger, the brother of a state senator and the most infamous violent criminal in the history of South Boston, who became an FBI informant to take down a Mafia family invading his turf.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2021 · House of Gucci
metas.description: When Patrizia Reggiani, an outsider from humble beginnings, marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel their legacy and triggers a reckless spiral of betrayal, decadence, revenge, and ultimately...murder.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2016 · Snowden
metas.description: The NSA's illegal surveillance techniques are leaked to the public by one of the agency's employees, Edward Snowden, in the form of thousands of classified documents distributed to the press.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2004 · Monster
metas.description: Based on the life of Aileen Wuornos, a Daytona Beach prostitute who became a serial killer.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1979 · Escape from Alcatraz
